sla_preferences: Uptime target requested: 99.9% for dedicated pool (monthly)
Credit schedule requested: tiered credits (0.1-0.5% downtime -> 10% service credit, 0.5-2% -> 30%, >2% -> 60%)
Maintenance windows: monthly maintenance only during 02:00-04:00 US-Eastern; customer must have 48hr advance notice
Support: P1 response < 1 hour, P2 response < 4 hours, business-hours engineering bridge for rollouts
Planned rolling upgrades require failover to warm standby or explicit traffic drain policy — no hard outages for minor kernel patches
